name: The Seamen's Home Nuuk
description:
Three star hotel with a view of the harbor and a great atmosphere

Regardless if you are a sailor, a workman or a tourist, you are always welcome at the seamen’s home in Nuuk. The seamen’s home is a three star hotel with 41 rooms, four of which are handicap friendly. The seamen’s home is located on the harbor and offers a great view of the sea, the mountains and the many activities on the harbor. Our guests especially enjoy the quiet atmosphere, which provides the setting for a good nights sleep. Furthermore, they always appreciate the homely atmosphere and the high standard of service. All rooms are large and light, and contain a hotspot, phone and a TV. We offer rooms of different standards and at different price levels. Our cafeteria offers a large menu, and we are known for our high quality food. Many locals have their daily meals in our cafeteria. The seamen’s home is often used for conference – and course purposes. We have a new and modern conference room with room for 30 people. Here you will have all the electronic equipment you need. We also have a number of smaller group rooms.We will do our best to give you a pleasant stay, and are looking forwards to seeing you.
